description: Fork of exp303 (SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Single trade: residual_lut gains sparse_scatter with per-table n_outputs=128 (halfway between exp315's 64 and dense exp303's 384) fanning out to sparse_scatter_n_outputs=D=384. residual_lut params/layer 50.3M -> 16.8M (3x reduction); model total ~602M -> ~400M. Each D-slot is summed from ~683 of 2048 tables (balanced default, 128*2048/384). Entries per D-slot 131,072 -> ~43,690. Brackets exp315's +0.022 bpb gap from the other side — tests whether the sparse-residual penalty is a smooth function of per-table n_outputs.
